summary: Local coverage of Chharra is thin: complaints centre on potholed state and village roads around Chharra Adda and Galibpur and on an alleged assault at the Chharra mandi, while appreciation is limited to the mandi as a market and a rural link road, and several positives are flagged inference.

positives.english: *The Chharra mandi gives our farmers a local place to sell their crops
positives.hindi: *छर्रा की मंडी में फसल बेचने की अपनी जगह है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026, checked) names the Chharra Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti as the site where a porter was injured in a dispute with traders on 22 Sep. The article does not describe farmers using the mandi or praising it; appreciation is inferred. Chharra town is the namesake town of AC 74, so the mandi is inside the AC.

positives.english: The PM Gram Sadak road from Galibpur is the main link for our villages
positives.hindi: गालिबपुर की प्रधानमंत्री ग्राम सड़क गांवों को मुख्य रास्ते से जोड़ती है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (2 Jul 2026, checked): resident Vinod Kumar says the about 1.5 km road from Galibpur gram panchayat (Gangiri block) to the Chharra-Kasganj route is 'कई गांवों के लोगों के लिए मुख्य संपर्क मार्ग है' (the main link for many villages). AC membership unconfirmed: Galibpur is not named in the AC's Wikipedia extent. District-level. The road is in poor condition, so this praises its role, not its state.

positives.english: *Security arrangements were made for the festival procession in Chharra
positives.hindi: *त्योहार की सवारी के लिए छर्रा में सुरक्षा का इंतज़ाम हुआ
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (10 Oct 2026, checked on the video page; headline and summary only) reports the SSP inspected the Ram Barat procession route in Chharra, the Ravan dahan site, and gave security instructions to organisers. The report does not record any resident's praise; appreciation is inferred. A security check is not a delivered benefit, so this is a weak positive.

positives.english: *Rs 216 crore budget is set aside for 79 roads in Chharra
positives.hindi: *छर्रा की 79 सड़कों के लिए 216 करोड़ रुपये का बजट है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked) budget list gives Rs 216 crore for 79 roads of 250 km in the Chharra assembly area. This is a budget allocation, not a started or completed work; no resident praise is reported. Weak positive.

positives.english: *The Atrauli-Kasganj state road takes us to towns beyond Chharra
positives.hindi: *अतरौली-कासगंज राज्य मार्ग से छर्रा के बाहर के शहरों तक जाते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked) calls the Atrauli-Kasganj road a state highway that passes Pali Morh and Chharra Adda. The article names no destination towns and reports no resident praise; the appreciation is inferred and this is the weakest positive in the set.

negatives.english: The Atrauli-Kasganj road has deep potholes from Pali Morh to Chharra Adda
negatives.hindi: अतरौली-कासगंज रोड पर पाली मोड़ से छर्रा अड्डा तक गहरे गड्ढे हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked), reporter narration with no named speaker: 'अतरौली-कासगंज रोड पर पाली मोड़ से छर्रा अड्डा तक एक किलोमीटर के टुकड़े में गहरे गड्ढे हैं', state highway. Article covers 17 ACs in four districts, so it is district-level, but Chharra Adda is inside Chharra town (Chharra NP), listed in the AC's Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: A porter at the Chharra mandi is alleged to have been assaulted by traders in a dispute
negatives.hindi: छर्रा मंडी में पल्लेदार पर व्यापारियों के हमले का आरोप है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026, checked): porter Raju was injured on 22 Sep at the Chharra Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti; the family alleges assault by two traders; FIR against 8 named persons and about 90 people in all (about 30 women); villagers allege police were not taking the case seriously (allegation only). Traders' version not in article. Police gave a different time for the incident (about 10:30 pm) than the family (about 8 pm).

negatives.english: The Nanau to Chharra-Sankra road is damaged
negatives.hindi: नानऊ से छर्रा-सांकरा सड़क जर्जर हो चुकी है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked), reporter narration with no named speaker: 'अकराबाद में जीटी रोड स्थित नानऊ चौराहे से छर्रा-सांकरा जाने वाली सड़क भी जर्जर हो चुकी है'. Nanau Chauraha is on GT road in Akarabad, and Akarabad KC is in AC 74's extent (Wikipedia), so the road starts inside AC 74. Sankra is not confirmed. Counted as AC-specific. The article covers 17 ACs in the Aligarh division, so the source is district-level.

negatives.english: The Galibpur road has deep potholes and is hard to use in rain
negatives.hindi: गालिबपुर की सड़क में गहरे गड्ढे हैं, बारिश में निकलना मुश्किल
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (2 Jul 2026, checked): the PMGSY road from Galibpur gram panchayat (Gangiri block) to the Chharra-Kasganj route has deep potholes that fill with rainwater, so drivers cannot judge their depth; resident Vinod Kumar says 'हालत इतनी खराब हो चुकी है कि बारिश में निकलना मुश्किल हो जाता है'. Galibpur is not named in the AC 74 extent on Wikipedia: AC membership unconfirmed, so not counted as AC-specific. No official speaks in the article.

negatives.english: *For treatment, Aligarh is 40 km away and it can only be reached by road
negatives.hindi: *इलाज के लिए अलीगढ़ 40 किमी दूर, सिर्फ सड़क से जा सकते हैं
negatives.basis: Inference: Wikipedia (Chharra Rafatpur, undated, checked) says the town is '40 km from district headquarters Aligarh' and 'The only way to commute to this place is by road'. The page names no hospital or health service; the health-access claim is inferred from distance and road-only access. The page describes it as a nagar panchayat in Aligarh district, and the AC page lists Chharra NP in the extent.

Field check: Chharra NP water and drainage, Chharra Adda drain and the Chharra mandi, Nanau-Sankra and Pilkhana roads, Galibpur road membership, the 216 crore 79-road allocation, and the status of the 22 Sep mandi case.
